_what_this_is: Report sites that can be silenced without any battery noticing. Each is a rule
with no case: the case that appears to test it is green for some other reason.
THIS FILE IS A RATCHET, NOT AN AMNESTY. gate-coverage-sweep.sh fails on a
survivor that is NOT listed here (a new hole) and it also fails on an entry
listed here that no longer survives (a hole that was closed, or a rule that
moved). The second half is what gives it teeth: closing a hole obliges you to
delete its line, so the list can only shrink.
open     - a real coverage hole, ticketed, waiting for a case to be written
accepted - a survivor somebody looked at and decided to keep, with the reason
Anchors are library::qualified.function#ordinal, the ordinal counting report
sites inside that function. Line numbers were tried and rot on contact: an edit
above a site moves it, and the entry silently transfers to whatever rule
inherited the number. Renaming the function DOES move the anchor, and that is
correct - the entry was written about a rule that no longer has that name.

measured.note: The three routing_stage entries were invisible to every earlier version of this sweep: it looked only for a sibling gate-<lib>.selftest.sh, and six of the sixteen libraries do not have one. Their absence was never printed, so the previous headline of 24 survivors was a statement about ten sixteenths of the repository with nothing saying which ten.
